title: Study of Thyroid Dysfunction in Immune Thrombocytopenic Purpura Patients
off: Study of Thyroid Dysfunction in Patients With Immune Thrombocytopenic Purpura at Sohag University Hospital
summary: Study of relation between thyroid dysfunction and immune thrombocytopenic purpura patients and if there is relation between them
elig:
Inclusion Criteria:

* 1\. Patient newly diagnosed immune thrombocytopenia.

  2- No current thyroid therapy.

  3-Able to provide informed consent and required clinical data (age, sex, ITP duration/therapy, bleeding history

Exclusion Criteria:

* 1\. Known thyroid disease or prior thyroid therapy:

  * Prior thyroidectomy, radioiodine, antithyroid drugs, or levothyroxine

    2\. Acute or critical illness within the past 4-6 weeks (non-thyroidal illness syndrome)
  * ICU admission, major surgery, severe infection/trauma

    3\. Medications that acutely suppress or distort TSH around sampling
  * High-dose glucocorticoids, dopamine/dobutamine infusions

arms.d: Patients newly diagnosed with immune thrombocytopenia (ITP) who meet the study eligibility criteria. Participants will undergo clinical assessment, complete blood count (CBC), and thyroid function testing, including thyroid-stimulating hormone (TSH), free triiodothyronine (FT3), free thyroxine (FT4), anti-thyroid peroxidase antibodies (Anti-TPO), and anti-thyroglobulin antibodies (Anti-TG).
i: Diagnostic Test: Laboratory tests TSH, FT3, FT4 ,anti thyroglobulin antibodies, Anti -TPO antibodies

arms.d: Apparently healthy individuals matched to the patients with immune thrombocytopenia (ITP) for age and sex. Participants will undergo thyroid function testing, including thyroid-stimulating hormone (TSH), free triiodothyronine (FT3), free thyroxine (FT4), anti-thyroid peroxidase antibodies (Anti-TPO), and anti-thyroglobulin antibodies (Anti-TG).
